violations: The proposed ratingAsOf assignment is unsupported: the ScoutMetric observation supplies only facts.rating=93, while its observedAt and effectiveAt timestamps do not establish a published ratingAsOf value.
Policy permits ScoutMetric ownership of ratingAsOf but does not authorize inferring that field from an observation timestamp absent a stated mapping or fact.
residualRisks: The rating-only update to 93 is supported; a corrected proposal would preserve the existing ratingAsOf until authoritative timestamp evidence is supplied.
summary: The proposal correctly scopes the rating update and preserves the RankGrid value, but its bundled ratingAsOf change is not grounded in the authoritative observation.
